newsitem.title: USA: Federal Express up on China expansion.
newsitem.headline: Federal Express up on China expansion.

text.p: Shares of Federal Express Corp rallied to a strong close on Monday after a report that the company would expand its delivery area in China by 20 cities a year over the next five years, analysts said.

"China is a very big market and there is no one there except for Federal Express," said Jeffrey L. Pittsburg, an analyst who covers the company for Goldis-Pittsburg Institutional Services. "There's no question in my mind that is the reason (for Monday's rally)."
He was referring to a report in the China Daily Business Weekly on Sunday that quoted the company's general managewr for China, E. Brooke Harwood.
It also quoted him as saying that Federal Express was considering increasing scheduled flights between the United States and China to four a week from the current two.
The paper said that Federal Express was the only U.S. all-cargo carrier allowed to fly to and from China.
